detail: Prune old draft revisions; normalise roots (NFC/NFD, symlinks) and web prefixes the way enforcement will match; clearer refusal when a bare node/bun/deno above 'orch' makes orchd refuse the operator, and don't count doubled '/' toward the depth limit; a session can keep saving drafts so the operator's apply is always stale; 'orch status' should say nothing is readable when the newest apply fails to verify; resolve root symlinks before nesting checks; transient changed_outside_orchd during an apply.
